name: GravitLauncher LaunchServer
author: vadim@saythe.ru
description: GravitLauncher LaunchServer for Pterodactyl. Uses a custom JDK 25 image with OpenJFX 25 jmods and installs official GravitLauncher release artifacts from GitHub.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

VERSION="${GRAVIT_VERSION:-5.7.12}"
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/GravitLauncher/Launcher/releases/download/v${VERSION}/LaunchServerBuild.zip"

echo "Installing GravitLauncher LaunchServer v${VERSION}"

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends unzip
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

curl -fL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o /tmp/LaunchServerBuild.zip

rm -rf /tmp/gravit-launchserver
mkdir -p /tmp/gravit-launchserver
unzip -q /tmp/LaunchServerBuild.zip -d /tmp/gravit-launchserver

if [ -d /tmp/gravit-launchserver/launchserver ]; then
    SOURCE_DIR="/tmp/gravit-launchserver/launchserver"
else
    SOURCE_DIR="/tmp/gravit-launchserver"
fi

cp -a "${SOURCE_DIR}/." /mnt/server/

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/bin/launchserver ]; then
    echo "ERROR: bin/launchserver was not found after extraction"
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x /mnt/server/bin/launchserver

rm -rf /tmp/gravit-launchserver /tmp/LaunchServerBuild.zip

echo "GravitLauncher LaunchServer v${VERSION} installed successfully"

variables.name: GravitLauncher Version
variables.description: GravitLauncher version to install. Example: 5.7.12. Reinstall the server after changing this value to update LaunchServer files.

variables.name: External Address
variables.description: Public HTTPS address used by LaunchServer when LaunchServer.json is generated for the first time. Do not add /api. Example: https://launcher.example.com

variables.description: Project name used when LaunchServer.json is generated for the first time.
